verdict.rationale: Dagster documents an official Dagster+ MCP server that lets an AI session access information and take actions in a Dagster+ deployment, and a probe confirms the dedicated docs page exists. The evidence is limited to a one-line description, and it applies to Dagster+ deployments specifically. Missing for 10: details on setup, auth and the exposed tools/actions, evidence of support for OSS (non-Dagster+) deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Dagster+ MCP server allows you to access information and take actions in your Dagster+ deployment within an AI session.
